instructions: Pubky Market is a local-first marketplace built on the Pubky App architecture (Next.js, React with the React Compiler, Dexie/IndexedDB, Zustand, TanStack Query, Tailwind and Shadcn UI). AGENTS.md is the agent entry point; docs/ is canonical and relevant docs are attached through files.json. Enforce the documented layer boundaries, concrete imports, local-first reads/writes and code-quality rules in docs/development-workflow.md. Preserve the Marketplace service, embedding, grant-session and release contracts. Review the actual diff and verify each finding against source; do not infer App-only APIs or require unrelated refactors. Marketplace uses the App toast API with durationMs and retains its own Linux VRT and pre-push/PR checks. Review .greptile/rules.md as a summary of the canonical docs.

rules.rule: Controllers must NOT import from services directly. All IO must go through the Application layer.
Coordinators must NOT call Application directly. They must go through Controllers.
Application layer must NOT access Zustand stores directly. Stores are managed by Controllers.
Pipes must be pure functions. No IO, no database access, no network calls.
Do not log errors before throwing Err.* factories. Err.* factories log automatically. Logging then throwing causes double-logged errors.

Only PostApplication, NotificationApplication, BootstrapApplication, MigrationApplication, HotApplication, PostStreamApplication, and TtlApplication may call other Applications. Max call depth is 1 by default. The only permitted depth-2 paths are PostApplication, NotificationApplication, or TtlApplication calling PostStreamApplication, which may call FileApplication for attachment persistence. All other depth-2 paths, paths of depth 3 or greater, and cycles are forbidden.
Always check for Shadcn equivalent components before creating custom UI. Use Shadcn primitives as base.

Stock Lucide icons: import from 'lucide-react' only. Custom/brand SVG components: import from '@/icons' (tsconfig alias → src/libs/icons/icons.tsx). Do not re-export lucide-react from @/libs or add export * from 'lucide-react' through aggregate index files. URL→icon helpers (getIconFromUrl) belong in @/libs/utils (urlToIcon). See docs/components.md — Icons.
Never hardcode counts or quantities in skeleton components. Source from constants or props.

Avoid index.ts / index.tsx files that only re-export from children, and avoid pushing symbols through intermediate re-export modules without a strong reason. That pattern adds indirection, confuses go-to-definition, makes circular deps harder to trace, and can defeat tree-shaking. Import from the defining source file. Hooks and core layers: use @/hooks/*, @/controllers/*, @/services/*, @/models/*, @/stores/*. Config: @/config/<module> only (no src/config/index.ts aggregate). Routes: @/app/routes. Components: no src/components/**/index.ts or index.tsx that only re-export; import concrete files via @/atoms/*, @/molecules/*, @/organisms/*, @/templates/* (for example @/atoms/Button/Button).

Every eslint-disable, eslint-disable-next-line, @ts-ignore, and @ts-expect-error must have an adjacent comment explaining WHY the suppression is needed. Bare suppressions hide real bugs. If a rule is wrong for the whole file, use a top-level eslint-disable with rationale rather than sprinkling inline ignores.

Remove unreachable branches, unused variables, commented-out blocks, and code guarded by conditions that are always true or false. Dead code misleads readers and inflates bundle size. Don't comment code out 'for later' — git preserves history. If a feature flag is permanently on/off, collapse the branch.

If a function, const, type, or class is exported but never imported by any other file, remove the export or demote to a local. Stale exports clutter the public API surface. Only exception: symbols consumed by external packages or test harnesses — add a comment like '// exported for integration tests'.

When a function has 3+ optional parameters that change its behavior (not just defaults), it likely hides multiple responsibilities. Prefer an options object, explicit overloads, or separate functions. A single function with many optional params makes call sites ambiguous and testing harder.

This project uses the React Compiler which auto-memoizes renders and callbacks. Manual useCallback and useMemo are redundant in most cases and add visual noise. Flag them unless the author cites a specific reason the compiler can't handle it (e.g., ref-stable callback for a non-React subscriber, or profiler evidence of a hotspot).

Controller method names encode IO: fetch* is network-only, get* local-only, getMany* a bulk local Map, getOrFetch* and getMany*OrFetch local-first with network fallback, subscribe* a long-lived stream, commitCreate*/commitUpdate*/commitDelete* a local-first write plus sync. Check new or changed methods against docs/local-first.md.

For ordinary local-first entity reads, use useLocalFirstQuery from @/hooks/useLocalFirstQuery/useLocalFirstQuery: queryFn is local-only and read-only; fetchFn performs the network fetch and persists to Dexie. No network, TanStack Query or retry logic inside useLiveQuery (ADR-0011). Flag new hand-rolled equivalents without a documented reason. Preserve loading/missing/tombstone handling and the separate TTL freshness policy. See docs/local-first.md.

Writes to TTL-managed entities must update the affected *_ttl rows and persist dependencies before dependents. Do not impose social TTL tables on commerce records that have a different persistence contract. Check stream cursor and invalidation behavior against docs/data-patterns.md and docs/local-first.md.

Call out changes to DB_VERSION, stores/index definitions or upgrade callbacks and verify their effect on existing local data. Marketplace has versioned upgrades as well as reset paths; inspect the current franky.ts migration/reset implementation rather than assuming every version change deletes the database. Require migration/reset verification and describe any local-data loss. See docs/data-patterns.md.

Re-throw AppError unchanged and normalize unknowns with toAppError(). Use safeFetch and httpResponseToError or the documented service wrapper for HTTP. Prefer error.category/error.code over message matching; any SDK-boundary exception must be narrow, documented and contract-tested. Preserve the documented non-reporting expected-outcome exceptions. Do not add raw throw new Error() to core production code. See docs/error-handling.md and docs/sentry.md.

Route reportable application errors through Err.* and the existing captureAppError funnel. Do not add direct Sentry.captureException calls outside that funnel and the non-AppError cases in app/error.tsx and app/global-error.tsx. Preserve the expected-refusal and cancellation filtering described in docs/sentry.md. Do not attach raw private data or secrets; review context against the existing scrubber.

Use react-hook-form + zod behind an action/form hook, with schema, types and defaults in a sibling *.types.ts. Components call the hook rather than commit* controllers directly. Use Controller and the existing controlled-field molecules; validation messages are literal US-English strings and Zod v4 URL validation is z.url(). Preserve the documented success result contract, including entity IDs where callers need them. See docs/components.md.

Use semantic design tokens and the Tailwind scale; avoid hardcoded colors and fixed arbitrary values when a named utility exists. Use the documented z-index scale (-z-10, z-10, z-30, z-40, z-50, z-60). Allow viewport fractions without a named utility, necessary calc() expressions and library CSS variables. See docs/components.md and docs/z-index.md.

User-facing copy uses inline US-English literals. Do not restore next-intl, useTranslations, messages/ catalogs, src/i18n or a replacement translation registry. See docs/migrations/2305-i18n-conflict-guide.md.

For visual changes, identify affected VRT specs and state the baseline impact. Marketplace validates Linux Chromium/Firefox baselines using the pinned Docker runner and PR/merge-group workflows. Use the current commands in docs/visual-regression-testing.md; regenerate only intentional visual changes, inspect the diff and preserve unrelated baselines. Do not claim VRT ran when the job was skipped.

Do not hand-edit generated service-worker output or lockfile entries. Change the source/input and regenerate with the appropriate tool. Review the resulting diff and disclose generated-file changes; do not regenerate unrelated outputs. See docs/development-workflow.md.

Homeserver writes use the existing HomeserverService boundaries and retry policy (429/500/503 and the narrowly recognized publish-conflict 409, not arbitrary 409/412/423). For a write checked against a read of the same file, preserve the read-dependent retry contract: publish conflicts must re-run the read/check rather than replay stale data. Verify the actual Marketplace helper and session/locking behavior in source; do not import an App-only API. See docs/error-handling.md.

Unit tests assert observable behavior and prop contracts; VRT checks appearance. Do not add classic snapshot tests, as any, or as unknown as T escapes outside documented typed test helpers. Avoid assertions that only prove an import exists or a render does not throw; test the relevant behavior. See docs/component-testing.md.
